title: An ALMA Survey of Faint Disks in the Chamaeleon I Star-forming Region: Why Are Some Class II Disks so Faint?
question: Why are some Class II disks in Chamaeleon I so faint at mm wavelengths, and does the stellar-disk mass scaling relation hold with deeper data?

evidence.quote: stellar masses are adopted from (cite: pascucci2016)
Spectral types are adopted from (cite: manara2016; manara2017)
References for stellar multiplicity are (cite: lafrenire2008) and (cite: daemgen2013).
Column 6 and 7 are 887$\mu$m fluxes in (cite: pascucci2016) and this work.

recipe.method: Average continuum channels of calibrated visibilities, natural weighting in clean
uvmodelfit point-source or elliptical Gaussian fits to visibilities; uncertainties scaled by sqrt reduced chi2; non-detections refit with fixed offsets
key_parameters: Detection if flux >3 sigma near expected position

recipe.method: Same assumptions as Pascucci 2016, constant T=20 K, distance 190 pc
Linmix Bayesian linear regression in log-log plane including upper limits, with and without outliers
assumptions: Linear relation in log-log plane with Gaussian scatter

recipe.goal: Model SED of CHXR30A with circumsecondary disk
recipe.method: RADMC-3D SED model; two stars 80 AU apart; secondary disk truncated at ~30 AU; disk-to-star mass ratio set to match mm upper limit
key_parameters: Secondary mass 0.28 Msun from Ks contrast 0.85

evidence.quote: the detection rate for the *Hot* Sample is now 94% (51/54)
a Gaussian fit with a mean value of 0.12 and 1$\sigma$ spread of 0.26

answer_key.quantity: Dust mass upper limits of non-detections

evidence.quote: The dust mass upper limits are only $\sim$0.2 $M_\ensuremath{\oplus}$

not_stated_but_needed: Dust opacity and gas-to-dust ratio values used for dust masses (deferred to Pascucci 2016)
Clean mask, threshold and image size/cell size
How the random 7% of Cool-sample upper limits was drawn
RADMC-3D disk and stellar parameters (inner radius, scale height, grain sizes)
Cycle 3 data reduction details beyond NRAO scripts
missing_for_reproduction: Dust opacity and gas-to-dust values (in Pascucci 2016)
score_reason: Simple measurements and public data, but dust-mass assumptions and several settings are deferred to earlier work.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, a simple uvmodelfit recipe, and numeric results (fluxes, scaling relation).
